name: Ingenium
label: EdTech venture
summary: Learning beyond the classroom. Built with purpose.
detail: Ingenium is an education startup incubated with the University of Sydney and TBI Chandigarh University, with deployment in multiple schools. The team secured first prize at ThinkLab Ideathon 2025. The venture brings together product thinking, education and collaborative problem-solving.

name: Spoken Language Identification
label: Samsung PRISM
summary: Making speech AI more robust across three languages.
detail: As a Samsung PRISM intern and team leader, Bhumi contributed to three worklets covering Hindi, Urdu and Punjabi. The research focused on improving spoken Language Identification robustness using physical-access speaker-spoofed parallel databases, supported by data preparation, experimentation and evaluation.
note: Samsung PRISM certificate shared on LinkedIn.
